scripts.common: node tools/viteBuild.js && node tools/localeTools/index.cjs build && find build -name '.DS_Store' -type f -delete
scripts.commonFf: FIREFOX=true node tools/viteBuild.js && FIREFOX=true node tools/localeTools/index.cjs build && find buildFf -name '.DS_Store' -type f -delete
scripts.prod: export NODE_ENV=production && npm run common   && cd build/unpacked   && zip -r '../global-speed-chromium.zip' .
scripts.prodFf: export NODE_ENV=production && npm run commonFf && cd buildFf/unpacked && zip -r '../global-speed-firefox.zip' .
scripts.prodFff: npm run prodFf && rm -rf zed && mkdir -p zed/unpacked && cp -r src static staticCh staticFf tools package-lock.json package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.js zed/unpacked && cp firefox-build.md zed/unpacked/README.md && (cd zed/unpacked && zip -r ../packed.zip .) && mv zed/packed.zip buildFf/source.zip && rm -rf zed
